scripts.test:e2e:packaged: npm run test:e2e:build:packaged && npm run test:e2e:run:packaged --
scripts.test:e2e:unpackaged: npm run test:e2e:build:unpackaged && npm run test:e2e:run:unpackaged --
scripts.test:e2e:build:packaged: cross-env DESKTOP_E2E_UPDATES_URL=http://127.0.0.1:51789/update NODE_ENV=production RELEASE_CHANNEL=production DESKTOP_E2E=1 npm run build:electron:prod --
scripts.test:e2e:build:unpackaged: cross-env DESKTOP_E2E_UPDATES_URL=http://127.0.0.1:51789/update NODE_ENV=production RELEASE_CHANNEL=production DESKTOP_SKIP_PACKAGE=1 npm run build:electron:prod --
scripts.start:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production RELEASE_CHANNEL=production node --import tsx script/start-rust-package.ts
scripts.compile:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite build -c vite.main.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node --import tsx node_modules/webpack-cli/bin/cli.js --disable-interpret --config app/webpack.development.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite build -c vite.cli.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite build -c vite.crash.config.ts && vite build -c vite.highlighter.config.ts --outDir ../out --sourcemap
scripts.compile:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build -c vite.main.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=production NODE_OPTIONS='--max_old_space_size=4096' node --import tsx node_modules/webpack-cli/bin/cli.js --disable-interpret --config app/webpack.production.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build -c vite.cli.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build -c vite.crash.config.ts && vite build -c vite.highlighter.config.ts --outDir ../out --sourcemap
scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm vite:build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development DESKTOP_REQUIRE_NATIVE_PLATFORM=1 cargo build --locked -p desktop-app -p desktop-cli --features desktop-cli/embedded-ui
scripts.build:electron:dev: npm run compile:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node --import tsx script/build.ts
scripts.build:electron:prod: npm run compile:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node --import tsx script/build.ts
scripts.package: cross-env NODE_ENV=production RELEASE_CHANNEL=production DESKTOP_RUST_PACKAGE_PROFILE=release node --import tsx script/package-rust.ts
scripts.lint: npm run prettier && npm run lint:src && npm run lint:biome --
scripts.lint:fix: npm run prettier -- --write && npm run lint:src:fix && biome check --write . --
scripts.lint:src: npm run lint:security && npm run eslint-check && npm run eslint --
scripts.lint:src:fix: npm run lint:security && npm run eslint -- --fix
scripts.clean-slate: rimraf out node_modules app/node_modules && npm ci
scripts.rebuild-hard:dev: rimraf out node_modules app/node_modules && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && git submodule update --init --recursive && pnpm build:dev
scripts.rebuild-hard:prod: rimraf out node_modules app/node_modules && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && git submodule update --init --recursive && pnpm build:prod
scripts.rebuild-hard:electron:prod: npm run clean-slate && npm run build:electron:prod --
scripts.draft-release:format: node --import tsx script/draft-release/format-json-cli.ts changelog.json app/package.json && npm run validate-changelog --
